decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of spirits and tempo plays to apply pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By playing creatures with flash like Shacklegeist and Spell Queller, the deck can dictate the pace of the game and protect key threats. Cards like Curious Obsession help maintain card advantage and push damage through, while counterspells like Lofty Denial provide additional disruption. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck while also maximizing flexibility for plays.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability, allowing it to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. It also includes cards like Thing in the Ice and Ledger Shredder to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to efficiently remove threats, while also including card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise to maintain card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy while utilizing the graveyard as a resource.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes powerful late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out the game. With a mix of removal, hand disruption, and efficient threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on aggressive plays that revolve around sacrificing creatures for value through cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven. By utilizing Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute, the deck can steal and sacrifice opponent's creatures to gain an advantage. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and the versatile Kolaghan's Command to control the board. The companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an extra element to deck building strategy. Overall, the key concept is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and sacrifice synergies.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence quickly by playing low-cost green creatures and using mana acceleration. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and powerful green creatures, while also utilizing devotion to green to generate extra mana from Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Cavalier of Thorns to bring additional threats onto the battlefield. Overall, the strategy is to ramp up quickly and maintain pressure on the opponent to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using green creatures and enchantments to play powerful green devotion cards such as Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival help to search for key pieces and maintain board presence. Lovestruck Beast provides early aggression while Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx generates massive amounts of mana. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship offers removal and Lair of the Hydra can create a powerful threat. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast, efficient green aggro strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II combo to generate overwhelming board presence and win the game. By utilizing cards like Raffine's Informant and Eldritch Evolution to find and play these key pieces, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and game-ending combos. Thoughtseize and Duress help to disrupt opponents' strategies, while cards like Seasoned Hallowblade and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional support and control options. With a mix of graveyard recursion and efficient ramp, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue opponents to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing various cards to quickly assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which consists of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. By utilizing cards like Stitcher's Supplier, Satyr Wayfinder, and Grisly Salvage to fill the graveyard, the deck aims to bring out the combo pieces for a powerful win condition. With support cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship providing additional value, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and deadly combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruption spells to pressure the opponent quickly and efficiently. By deploying threats like Luminarch Aspirant, Werewolf Pack Leader, and Lovestruck Beast alongside disruptive cards like Reflector Mage and Elite Spellbinder, the deck aims to create a powerful board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Collected Company allows for additional creature deployment and flexibility in responding to various threats. The deck's mana base is designed to support a mix of white, green, and blue spells, enabling a diverse range of plays.

The main concept of this deck is to focus on creating a strong devotion to green mana by utilizing cards that benefit from having a high number of green mana symbols on the battlefield. The deck aims to ramp up quickly with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, while also generating additional mana through Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck then looks to play powerful green creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Old-Growth Troll, while also having access to cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to further support its aggro strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Satyr Wayfinder, and then use cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand, as well as removal and recursion spells to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil for additional pressure and control options.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play and discard cards to quickly bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It utilizes spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to help with discard mechanics and removal, while also benefiting from card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise. The inclusion of Thing in the Ice helps with board control and offers an alternate win condition. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early, while maintaining card advantage and flexibility through its spells and card draw abilities.

This deck is focused on quickly playing multiple spells in a turn to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The strategy involves casting spells like Opt, Lightning Axe, and Fiery Impulse to trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability and bring it back to the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Pieces of the Puzzle and Treasure Cruise to help draw through the deck and find key pieces. Galvanic Iteration can also be used to copy spells for additional value. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient spellcasting.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells and use them to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated attacks, while also utilizing powerful draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent by casting cheap spells and overwhelming them with a flurry of attacks from Arclight Phoenix, while also being able to control the board with removal spells and counter magic.

The main idea of this deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Youthful Valkyrie and Righteous Valkyrie, backed up by support cards like Bishop of Wings and Giada, Font of Hope. Collected Company helps to quickly refill the board with additional threats, while Skyclave Apparition and portable Hole provide removal options. The deck also includes cards like Resplendent Angel for additional value and staying power. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and resilient creature-based strategy in a Selesnya Aggro shell.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, efficient white creatures to quickly build a strong board presence. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to boost the power and toughness of your creatures, combined with protection spells like Brave the Elements, you can quickly push for damage and control the battlefield. Mutavault and other land cards provide additional flexibility and utility, allowing you to adapt to different situations and maintain pressure on your opponent.
